{"code": "import math

# Re-run t-test using math module for t-distribution
# Use approximation for p-value

# T-statistic and degrees of freedom from earlier
t_stat = 0.6543
# df = 724.12  # from earlier calculation

# Use approximation: for large df, t-distribution ≈ normal
# p-value ≈ 2 * (1 - norm.cdf(abs(t_stat)))
# But we don't have norm. Use math.erf

# Approximate p-value using normal distribution
z = abs(t_stat)
p_val = 2 * (1 - 0.5 * (1 + math.erf(z / math.sqrt(2))))

print(f'Approximate p-value: {p_val:.6f}')"}
